title: Pro Trek Solar Watch PRG-340-3DR
description:
Go bold and bright. Get out and explore the great outdoors! Get the PRO TREK PRG-340SC with dual-layer LCD, featuring environmentally responsible materials.

This is the first PRO TREK timepiece with a Dura Soft band made from reused resin scraps left over from manufacturing processes. In keeping with the PRO TREK commitment to reducing environmental impact by using sustainable materials, reused resin scraps are an excellent complement to a line of watches.

Taking its cue from the PRG-340, key components for the case, rotating bezel, and case back are made with bio-based resin. Produced using renewable organic resources, this material is another way to help reduce environmental impact.

Not just nature loving, but practical, too. The Triple Sensor delivers compass bearing, barometric pressure, temperature, and altitude readings. The dual-layer LCD ensures outstanding visibility of compass graphics shown on the top layer and various measurements on the large display on the bottom layer
